phases.name: acquirePluginDescriptor
phases.doc: Admits the package descriptor and binds the activation registry and the shard client.

phases.name: createInstanceBookkeeping
phases.doc: Creates the per-instance maps, the lifecycle flags and the actor, channel and ui route guards.

phases.name: createRenderSurface
phases.doc: Renders one surface through the owned ui route inside the actor chain.

phases.name: createTurnDrivers
phases.doc: Builds the outcome broadcast, the spawned job drain, the typed operation drain and the queued turn driver.

phases.name: createExtensionCompletion
phases.doc: Builds the empty invocation and the extension completion capture.

phases.name: createRequestActor
phases.doc: Builds the lazily activated request actor and the extension invoke and dispatch functions.

phases.name: createContributionsAndBackbone
phases.doc: Builds the scoped contributions push and the document backbone turns.

phases.name: buildPluginHandle
phases.doc: Assembles the plugin handle over the closure state of the earlier groups.
